title: Distribution list not delivering
symptom: Emails sent to a team distribution list are not reaching its members
user_description: A customer says they emailed sales@ our company and it bounced. When I send to it from inside it works. What's wrong?

options.text: Delete the list and create it again
options.why: You would lose its settings and members without finding the cause.

options.text: Ask the customer to email each salesperson one by one
options.why: Avoids the problem and makes life harder for customers.

options.text: Check the members, whether outside senders are allowed (many lists only accept mail from inside the company), any moderation settings, and run a message trace
options.why: It works internally but bounces from outside, which points to the list only accepting internal senders. The trace confirms what happened.
Weakens protection for everyone and is not the cause here.

hints: What is different between internal and external senders?
Can a list be set to accept mail only from inside?
What does the bounce message say?
real_world_tip: Allowing outside senders on a list can bring in spam, so check with the list owner before changing it.
